figures.finding: The Falklands have no licence for child performers: the 1966 Ordinance bars employing any child (of or under compulsory school age) under fourteen, before school closes, before 07:00 or after 19:00, for more than two hours on a school day or a Sunday, or in harmful work; only a chorister at a religious service and a baby-sitter of fourteen or over are carved out, so the general rule reaches acting, writing or directing work alike. Regulations may add limits but may not relax these save for parents' light farm work and an hour before school.
figures.applies: Falkland Islands, children of or under compulsory school age.
